title: Library test (replayable script)
description: Saved from a Test Agent's transcript when a case passes (`usage --batch --transcript`). Lives in .qa/tests/<planId>/<tcId>.json; older versions in .history/. Never contains credentials: the login is {{user}} and {{secret}}, filled in memory at replay time.

tags.description: From the plan case at first recording; edited in the viewer after that and kept across versions.

group.description: Cases of one group replay together, in one browser, in `order`.

secret.description: Where the replay runner reads the password; QA_PASSWORD otherwise.

setup.description: What the agent did before marking its first case running (the login); run once per group.

recordedAfter.description: Earlier cases of the same agent session when there was no separate setup: this test may depend on them.

evidence.description: The files the agent reported for this step; a replay retakes them under the same names.

coveredBy.description: This step had no actions of its own; they were recorded with step n.

status.description: verified once a reviewer approves the run it was recorded from.

tool.description: The Playwright MCP tool that produced the code (click, type, navigate…).

code.description: Playwright code as Playwright MCP reported it ("Ran Playwright code").

marks.description: The marks array as JavaScript source; every selector must be found during replay.

optional.description: Selectors the agent's own capture did not find either.
